events.tagZh: 东南区 · 家庭同乐日
events.titleZh: Noble Park 春日家庭同乐日
events.summaryZh: 把动物展示、魔术、体育体验和舞蹈工作坊串成一段轻松的公园时光，大人还能逛餐摊与市集。入场和部分活动免费，游乐设施需另付费，适合一家人按兴趣挑着玩。
events.summaryEn: Mix animal shows, magic, sports activities and dance workshops with food and market stalls. Entry and some activities are free, while amusement rides cost extra; choose the parts your family enjoys.
events.placeZh: Ross Reserve，Memorial Drive，Noble Park；从 Corrigan Road 进入
events.placeEn: Ross Reserve, Memorial Drive, Noble Park VIC; entry via Corrigan Road
events.priceZh: 免费入场；游乐设施及餐饮另计
events.priceEn: Free entry; amusement rides and food extra
events.mapQuery: Ross Reserve, Corrigan Road, Noble Park VIC

linkReview.evidence: Council event detail confirms Sunday 25 October 2026 11am-4pm, Ross Reserve Memorial Drive, entry via Corrigan Road. Free community event, amusement rides for a fee, sports, animal/magic shows, dance and stalls. No cancellation notice on the checked detail page.

events.titleZh: Fed Square 印度尼西亚文化节
events.summaryZh: 一起听音乐、看传统与当代表演，再逛蜡染手作和印尼风味餐摊。白天来更适合家庭慢慢玩；两份官方页面的结束时间不一致，别把行程压到最后一小时。
events.summaryEn: Enjoy music, traditional and contemporary performances, batik crafts and Indonesian food. Visit during the day for a relaxed family outing; official closing times differ, so avoid leaving your visit until the final hour.
events.timeEn: Saturday 24 October from 10am; organiser lists 7pm close, venue 8pm
events.placeZh: Fed Square 主广场及 Swanston Street Forecourt
events.placeEn: Fed Square Main Square and Swanston Street Forecourt, Melbourne VIC
events.priceZh: 免费入场；餐饮及购物另计
events.priceEn: Free entry; food and shopping extra
events.referenceZh: Fed Square 与主办方，10月23日核实。
events.referenceEn: Fed Square and organiser, checked 23 October.

linkReview.evidence: Venue confirms free Saturday 24 October 2026, Main Square/Swanston Street Forecourt, 10am-8pm. Organiser https://festivalindonesia.com.au/2026-outdoor-festival/ lists 10am-7pm, food, music, performances and batik/craft workshops. Closing discrepancy disclosed; daytime visit recommended.

events.summaryZh: 到 Ruffey Lake Park 听本地音乐、逛手作和餐摊，再让孩子挑选动物农场、Scout World 或游乐项目。入场免费，但游乐票另购；户外活动出门前再看天气与主办方消息。
events.summaryEn: Listen to local musicians, browse craft and food stalls, and choose animal-farm, Scout World or ride activities at Ruffey Lake Park. Entry is free but ride tickets are separate; check weather and organiser updates before travelling.
events.placeZh: Ruffey Lake Park，George Street，Doncaster；停车从 King Street 进入
events.placeEn: Ruffey Lake Park, George Street, Doncaster VIC; parking entry off King Street
events.priceZh: 免费入场；游乐项目另计，官网预售游乐通票$25
events.priceEn: Free entry; rides extra, advertised advance ride pass $25
events.mapQuery: Ruffey Lake Park, George Street, Doncaster VIC
events.referenceZh: Rotary Manningham City 主办方，10月23日核实。
events.referenceEn: Rotary Manningham City organiser, checked 23 October.

linkReview.evidence: Organiser confirms 25 October 2026 9am-4pm, Ruffey Lake Park George Street Doncaster, free entry, King Street parking, stalls, animal farm, local entertainment, Scout World and rides. Advertised advance unlimited ride ticket $25. Separate all-age mental-health walk is optional; no participation requirement implied.

events.titleZh: Tarneit 万圣节家庭嘉年华
events.summaryZh: 穿上全家的装扮，挑选糖果活动、魔术、爬行动物展示和音乐节目，提前过一次万圣节。部分节目有惊吓元素，胆小的孩子可避开；骑乘与其他项目是否含在票内，订票时逐项确认。
events.summaryEn: Dress up together for trick-or-treat activities, magic, reptile shows and music. Some entertainment is spooky, so choose carefully for sensitive children and check which rides and activities each ticket includes.
events.placeEn: Penrose Place, 52 Wickford Road, Tarneit VIC
events.priceZh: 付费；按日期查看票种、费用与项目包含范围
events.priceEn: Paid; check dated ticket categories, fees and activity inclusions
events.mapQuery: Penrose Place, 52 Wickford Road, Tarneit VIC
events.referenceZh: 主办方 Humanitix 订票页，10月23日核实。
events.referenceEn: Organiser's Humanitix ticket page, checked 23 October.

linkReview.evidence: Official host ticket page confirms Saturday 24 and Sunday 25 October 2026, 2-9pm, Penrose Place opposite Tarneit Gardens Shopping Centre, 52 Wickford Road. Costume, trick-or-treat, horror/magic, reptiles, ponies, face painting and castles. Exact current ticket amounts/inclusions not exposed in text; no unverified numeric price quoted.

events.summaryZh: 跟着现场爵士乐，用软垫、毛毡、纸笔和丝带创作、搭建或跳舞。适合2–7岁孩子与大人一起参与，免费无需预约；空间光线较暗，满员时需要等候。
events.summaryEn: Create, build or dance with cushions, felt, drawing materials and ribbons alongside live jazz. For children aged 2–7 with an adult; free without booking. The space is dimly lit and entry may involve waiting at capacity.
events.placeEn: ArtPlay, Birrarung Marr, Russell Street Extension, Melbourne VIC
events.priceZh: 免费；无需预约，满员等候
events.priceEn: Free; no booking, waiting possible at capacity
events.referenceZh: Melbourne International Jazz Festival，10月23日核实。
events.referenceEn: Melbourne International Jazz Festival, checked 23 October.

linkReview.evidence: Festival organiser confirms 22-25 October 2026 daily 10:30am-12:30pm, ArtPlay Birrarung Marr, ages 2-7 with adult, free/no booking, capacity wait, dim lighting, jazz plus creative play. Current week dates narrowed to 23-25 October, not the previous week's Thursday alone.

events.summaryZh: 一起试彩色光线、视觉错觉和互动实验，把熟悉的颜色变成可动手探索的科学。官方建议5–14岁，适合学龄孩子与大人一起玩；展览票已包含 Scienceworks 入场。
events.summaryEn: Explore coloured light, optical illusions and hands-on experiments together. Recommended for ages 5–14 and enjoyable with adults; exhibition tickets include Scienceworks museum entry.
events.priceZh: 成人$25、儿童$10，含博物馆入场；优惠票见官网
events.priceEn: Adult $25, child $10, includes museum entry; concessions listed online
events.referenceZh: Museums Victoria 展览页，10月23日核实。
events.referenceEn: Museums Victoria exhibition page, checked 23 October.

linkReview.evidence: Museum exhibition page confirms until Tuesday 26 January 2027, 10am-4:30pm, 2 Booker Street Spotswood, recommended ages 5-14, adult $25/child $10 including museum entry. Interactive light and perception exhibits; do not replace exhibition price with general admission.

events.tagZh: 东南区 · 乐高主题体验
events.summaryZh: 一起搭恐龙、参加侏罗纪公园大门创作工坊，再到 Miniland 找隐藏的恐龙。主题活动包含在场馆门票中，适合喜欢动手搭建的孩子和大人一起探索。
events.summaryEn: Build dinosaurs, join the Jurassic Park gates workshop and hunt for dinosaurs in Miniland. The themed activities are included with admission, making a hands-on outing for children and adults to explore together.
events.timeZh: 9月8日–11月4日；按所选日期预约入场并查看开放日历
events.timeEn: 8 September–4 November; book a dated entry and check the opening calendar
events.placeEn: LEGOLAND Discovery Centre, Level 2, 1341 Dandenong Road, Chadstone VIC
events.priceZh: 主题活动含在入场票内；票价随日期和余票变化
events.priceEn: Themed activities included with admission; dated ticket prices vary
events.mapQuery: LEGOLAND Discovery Centre Melbourne, Chadstone VIC
events.referenceZh: LEGOLAND 官方主题活动页，10月23日核实。
events.referenceEn: LEGOLAND official themed event page, checked 23 October.

linkReview.evidence: Venue lists 8 September-4 November, all ages, included with admission, LEGO gates workshop, dinosaur builds and Miniland hunt. Page has expired 4 October sale alongside newer terms; no promotional numeric price reused. Dated entry/calendar required, not a fabricated fixed weekly timetable.

events.tagZh: 市中心 · 影像互动展
events.titleEn: The Story of the Moving Image at ACMI
events.summaryZh: 试着做光影动画、拼电影场景或给画面配音，再看看服装道具与电子游戏。免费、全龄适合，13岁以下需成人陪同；部分展示有闪烁效果，敏感家庭先查参观提示。
events.summaryEn: Try shadow animation, assemble film scenes or create sound effects, then explore costumes, props and videogames. Free and all ages; under-13s need an adult. Some displays contain strobing effects, so check visitor information if sensitive.
events.placeEn: ACMI Ground Floor, Fed Square, Melbourne VIC
events.referenceZh: ACMI 展览及参观规定，10月23日核实。
events.referenceEn: ACMI exhibition and visitor conditions, checked 23 October.

linkReview.evidence: Exact centrepiece exhibition page confirms ongoing free all-age exhibition, 10am-5pm, Ground Floor Fed Square, screen/game/animation/film-sound interactives. Under-13s require supervising adult, strobing warning. Not a generic venue-entry card.

moreLinks.sourceZh: AIFAV 官方订票 · 免费，需登记
moreLinks.sourceEn: AIFAV official booking · Free, registration required

linkReview.evidence: Organiser TryBooking page confirms 25 October 2026 1-3pm, Mick's Function Room 12-14 Tullidge Street Melton, free children 0-12, adult supervision, 50-child limit and each child registered, multicultural disco and indoor activities.

Venue lists Saturday 24 October 2026 6-8pm low sensory session, reduced sound/light/capacity and quiet spaces. Adults and children 2+ require tickets, annual passholders also reserve; valid Companion Card carers can book free. Separate timed specialist session, not duplicate ordinary admission.

moreLinks.sourceZh: Darebin Council · 0–5岁，需报名确认地点
moreLinks.sourceEn: Darebin Council · Ages 0–5, register for venue confirmation

linkReview.evidence: Council confirms 29 October 2026 10am-noon, free sensory/creative play for Darebin families with children 0-5, Reservoir. Booking essential; team confirms precise venue after registration. Low-age and story/rhyme content kept in More, no invented public street address.
